input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to SYCL 2020. The kernel is a 1-D parallel_for over buffers/accessors with sycl::tanh. Kernel timing uses queue profiling. All dpct headers, helpers and macros are removed. It compiles cleanly with add_dpct_include=false. I did not run the audio null test (-96 dBFS) because no tool for it was available, so numerical correctness is unverified. The math is the same as the CUDA kernel: norm * tanh(drive * x).
